text:
You need a developer who has previously implemented a ChatGPT plugin and can now help you consult on the approach and build your own plugin end to end.

I’m Noor Halden, and I can help with both milestones in your project: the 2-hour consulting session and the full ChatGPT plugin implementation. I have 6 years of experience working with Python, machine learning, NLP, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, and pandas, and I’ve built production AI systems that rely on tool use, retrieval, and agent-style orchestration.

One relevant project was a Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics. I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant that tracks parcels, reschedules deliveries, and hands off to a human with full context. That system used Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio, and it resolved 43% of conversations without an agent while achieving a CSAT of 4.4 out of 5. The project required careful tool calling, state handling, and reliable integration design—skills that map closely to plugin-style workflows.

I also built a Contract clause search assistant for a legal client. It answered questions over 9,000 contracts and always quoted the clause and page it used. That assistant used Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, pgvector, PostgreSQL, and FastAPI, and it achieved 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set while reducing clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. That experience is especially relevant for your legal/business context, where accuracy, traceability, and clear outputs matter.

For your first milestone, I can help you define the plugin’s scope, endpoints, data flow, authentication approach, and what should be handled by the plugin versus by the model. For the second milestone, I can implement the plugin cleanly and make sure it is structured for maintainability and future iteration.

If you’d like, I can start by reviewing your intended plugin behavior, then recommend the simplest reliable architecture before building.
